title: heo hook envelope
description: One event delivered to a plugin. Exec mode: one JSON object on stdin, then EOF. Subscriber mode: one object per line (NDJSON) on stdin. References only, never content: read what changed through heo, as the plugin's own actor.

heo_version.description: Envelope major version. A plugin refuses a major it does not know (exit 2).

plugin.description: Plugin name; the actor is plugin:<name>.

event_id.description: uma's event ID. Stable across redeliveries; the deduplication key.

attempt.description: Delivery attempt of this event to this plugin, 1 on first delivery.

event.description: The event as references only: IDs, kind, inbox, resource, conversation, message, label, operation, revision and times. Never a message body, a name, an address or any other content; the plugin reads that through heo as its own actor. The kinds a plugin may subscribe to, and the references each carries, are the catalog in manual/hooks.md.
